page.overview:
Who is The Water Shipper?

The Water Shipper was a ghola appointed by the Bene Tleilax to locate the Fremen.

The Water Shipper was subjected to hypno-ligation by the Bene Tleilax. He was sent to Arrakis and acquired a mansion by killing every member of the family who occupied it. He took control of the planet's water, intending to use it to find the Fremen, but they eluded him.

The Water Shipper discovered that the Prisoner had invaded his mansion. He watched them on the transeye and did not recognise them, which disturbed him. He told them of his mission and his failure to find the Fremen. Believing that the Sisterhood had sent them to check on his progress, insisting that he just needed more time in which to complete the mission. However, he drank water that had been poisoned by the Prisoner and attempted to tell them how to break the compulsion, but died before he could do so.
